name: Capernaum
overview: Capernaum holds significant importance in the ministry of Jesus as the place He chose to dwell after leaving Nazareth, situated on the sea coast within the borders of Zebulun and Naphtali. It is described as His 'own city,' where He performed powerful miracles, such as healing the paralytic and forgiving his sins, demonstrating His authority both to heal and to forgive. Despite these works, Jesus also pronounced prophecy against Capernaum, highlighting the tension between His gracious acts and the city's response to His message.
